sources.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Family of Models - NVIDIA Nemotron
sources.snippet: We announce NVIDIA Nemotron 3, the most efficient family of open models with leading accuracy for agentic AI applications. The Nemotron 3 family consists of three models: Nano, Super, and Ultra.

sources.title: Nemotron 3 Nano: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Abstract. We present Nemotron 3 Nano 30B-A3B, a Mixture-of-Experts hybrid Mamba-Transformer language model. Nemotron 3 Nano was pretrained on 25 trillion text tokens, including more than 3 trillion new unique tokens over Nemotron 2, followed by supervised fine tuning and large-scale RL on diverse environments.
